summary_en: Takahashi Kikaku Co., Ltd., a holding company fully owned by Shigeru Takahashi (HOB's chairman and largest shareholder with 40.07% stake), launched a tender offer to acquire all HOB shares excluding those held by Takahashi and HOB's treasury stock, aiming to delist HOB from Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market.
title_en: Notice of Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares of HOB Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 1382) by Takahashi Kikaku Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
Takahashi Kikaku Co., Ltd., an asset management company established on October 2, 2026, and wholly owned by Shigeru Takahashi, commenced a tender offer on November 6, 2026, to acquire all ordinary shares of HOB Co., Ltd. (Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market) except those held by Takahashi himself and HOB's treasury stock. The transaction constitutes a management buyout (MBO) in which Takahashi Kikaku will become the complete parent company and HOB will become a complete subsidiary through a share exchange following the tender offer.

Takahashi currently holds 305,000 shares representing 40.07% of HOB's outstanding shares (761,243 shares excluding treasury stock), and his spouse, Yukari Takahashi (third-largest shareholder), holds 22,000 shares (2.89%). The tender offer targets 456,243 shares, representing approximately 59.93% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. Takahashi has committed not to tender his shares and will vote in favor of post-offer consolidation procedures at an extraordinary shareholders' meeting, while Yukari Takahashi has indicated her intention to tender her entire holding. The offer aims to delist HOB and consolidate ownership between Takahashi Kikaku and Takahashi individually, with Takahashi expected to continue as chairman and representative director after completion.
